payload.title: File:Lower Dinosaur Park megafauna size.png
payload.description_html:
Diagram showing the dinosaur megafauna of the lower portion of the Dinosaur Park Formation based on existing works in Wikimedia Commons. Inclusions based on Mallon 2019.[1]

Original works are all public domain unless otherwise specified:

  • Parasaurolophus walkeri
  • Corythosaurus casuarius
  • Lambeosaurus lambei - CC BY-SA 4.0; original work File:Lambeosaurus_UDL.png
  • Gryposaurus notabilis
  • Gorgosaurus libratus
  • Daspletosaurus torosus - CC BY-SA 4.0; original work File:Daspletosaurus-Scale-Diagram.svg
  • Euoplocephalus tutus - CC BY-SA 4.0 ; original work File:O.A_Ankylosauridae_indet_profile_reconstruction.jpg
  • Edmontonia rugosidens - CC BY-SA 4.0; original work File:Edmontonia_Scale.svg
  • Centrosaurus apertus
  • Chasmosaurus russeli (or possibly C. belli or C. canadensis)
